correctness.rationale: Exhaustively test all 349525 scalar-normalized cubic forms on 21 points/lines. Both C++ and NumPy implementations agree on all 11368 tangent-filling equations and identify exactly 11088 with rational-line factors and 280 without. A line factor is exactly detected by containing all five rational points of a line. All 181440 invertible coordinate matrices generate a 280-element orbit of the smooth Hermitian cubic, exactly equal to the 280 no-line candidates; its projective stabilizer has order 216. An independent Jacobian-quadrics degree-four rank criterion confirms 280 geometrically smooth tangent-filling equations, ranks 11:5040,13:6048,15:280. All exact computations replayed from package paths.
